name: housebroken
title_zh: 给别人的仓库提 PR 前，先过这道门
tagline_zh: 改上游 bug、补 patch、回 maintainer 评论。
tagline_en: Fixing upstream bugs, answering reviews, cleaning up after merges—it keeps your manners in order before and after.
desc_en: The door every pull request to a repository you do not own must pass through before it is opened, and the manners it keeps after. Use whenever a task will end, or might end, in a pull request or issue on someone else's repository: fixing a bug found upstream, contributing a patch, filing a finding, answering a maintainer's review, or cleaning up after a merge or a close. Also use when the user say
why_zh: 它把开源协作里没人明说的潜规则变成显式检查：从提交信息到对话语气。
why_en: It turns unspoken OSS etiquette into explicit checks—commit messages, tone, scope—so you pass the maintainer's patience test.
limit_zh: 只覆盖你无权直接 push 的仓库流程；不审代码逻辑、不跑测试、不替你决定该不该提 issue。若目标仓库是你自己的。
limit_en: Only for repos you can't push to. Won't review code logic, run tests, or decide if an issue is warranted. Silently skips if the target repo is your.
title_en: The door every PR to a repo you don't own must pass
